purpose: Reproducible query specification for the Animas Gold King snapshot. Every file in data/raw/ was produced from this file by scripts/download.py (src/animas/acquire.py); the manifest records URLs, dates, headers, checksums and row counts.

wqp.source: Water Quality Portal (USGS NWIS + EPA WQX/STORET), legacy WQX 2.x web services

usgs_daily.source: USGS Water Data API (OGC API - Features), daily values collection

animas_above_cement.label: Animas River at Silverton, above Cement Creek

animas_cedar_hill.label: Animas River near Cedar Hill, New Mexico

notes: Reach membership was chosen from a WQP Station search (bBox=-108.10,36.90,-107.40,37.95, characteristicName=Zinc, startDateLo=01-01-2005) on 2026-10-09: partner stations within roughly 1 km of each USGS gauge on the same stream. 'Storm Opp' (opportunistic storm) stations were left out.
Both the legacy resultPhysChem profile and the WQX3 fullPhysChem profile were probed; the downloader records the WQX3 row count for the same query in the manifest so the comparison is reproducible.

Discharge: api.waterdata.usgs.gov (OGC API daily collection, api-version 1.9.8 on 2026-10-09) and the legacy waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/dv endpoint both answered; the new API is used and the legacy probe result is recorded in the manifest.
